messages:
sam_marketing: Heads-up designteam 9AM ask: compact launch kit for the "Inference Playbook" webinar next Wed.
sam_marketing: Needed: hero static + 3s loop GIF (1600x900), 1 benchmark sparkline (1200x400), 3 micro tiles (1080x1080, 1200x628, 320x480), and a simple inbound routing diagram for the registration page (1200x600).
Nina_design: Can do. Any hard copy yet? And do we need dark-mode variants?
sam_marketing: Copy below. Yes dark-mode variant required. Keep exports <250KB. Also need alt text suggestions. Deadline: first comps by Mon 9am PT, final by Tue noon.
omar_growth: Please include two CTA treatments for banners: "Register" (paid) and "Learn more" (organic). For paid banners use a stronger accent.
leah_prod: For the routing diagram, show: web form -> scoring -> "premium" queue or "standard" queue -> AE handoff. After 48h unassigned -> SDR. Show CRM tag field "inference_use_case" but keep it generic.
casey_legal: Quick flag: any comparative claim must be marked provisional. Send me exact wording for the hero and benchmark line and Ill review within 12h.
asset-bot: Uploaded figma://inference-playbook/1769998888 (preview https://figma-preview.example/1769998888) :white_check_mark:
Nina_design: Plan: will upload two hero comps (light/dark), sparkline mock, and routing sketch by Mon 09:00. Will add figma notes for alt text and export presets.
sam_marketing: Hero candidates for review: "Serve reliably. Pay less to run models." OR "The inference playbook: predictable latency, transparent cost." Use first for paid.
casey_legal: I prefer second for organic. Please tag me when hero copy is final.
omar_growth: Also need a 600x200 ad for paid channels, low priority but good to have.
Nina_design: Adding 600x200 and a 1:1 crop (1080x1080). Will label frames with asset codes and CTA variants.
sam_marketing: Thanks team 9AM. Ping if anything blocks.
